rationale: ECB's own IPR implementation hub fixes the application dates binding every SI PSP; recurring, authoritative.
AMI-Pay meeting packs are a recurring early-warning channel on scheme readiness; failed check is soft only.
EPC rulebook library is the operational deadline layer behind IPR for SI PSPs; versioned and recurring.
EPC news/consultation feed gives earliest visible signal of scheme change requests with hard deadlines.
Participant register is a lead list to mine for SI PSP adherence gaps, not a continuous signal feed.
ESRB recommendation feed carries dated act-or-explain obligations on SI authorities; standalone hub.
SL-language OJ L daily view is the authentic legal text fixing entry-into-force dates; highest credibility.
EUR-Lex SL homepage is a standalone legal database for consolidated texts and SI legal vocabulary.
Have Your Say lists dated feedback windows for PSD3/PSR/FIDA — earliest lead time in the EU pipeline.
Law-firm tracker on its own domain, useful discovery tripwire; secondary credibility, never primary evidence.
Bankart is the central SI processor; its payment-systems section is the anchor for BIPS/BIPS IP/SIMP docs.
Single dated PDF — a rulebook-equivalent artifact; monitor the parent Bankart page for new versions.
Operator news feed where SI scheme releases and migration milestones are first announced; distinct cadence.
Flik FAQ subsection of bankart.si with siblings; useful content but covered by monitoring the parent.
NSP meeting materials are the highest-yield SI-specific forward-deadline repository; recurring sessions.
BS oversight page defines dated reporting/licensing obligations on SI payment-system operators.
ZBS standards page publishes the binding UPN QR technical standard whose versions force market-wide migration.
National SEPA implementation hub localising EPC rulebooks into SI participant obligations; recurring.
Single ZBS notice stating IPR/VoP dates — strong evidence; the ZBS news hub is the monitorable parent.
Dedicated operations portal for the UPN QR standard with governance notices; standalone domain, no siblings.
UJP operates the public e-invoicing rail and sets e-SLOG version cut-offs binding on banks and ERP vendors.
Operator-run e-invoice issuer register; joins/leaves are observable recurring events on the SIMP rail.
One 2019 annual-report PDF — background evidence for scheme timelines, not a producing source.
Business-registry aggregator entry for one entity; mine once for identity/ownership, weak for A3 deadlines.
Wikipedia pointer to the Activa clearing rail; low credibility, use once as a lead then corroborate at BS.
Halcom vendor release notices name exact cut-off dates ahead of bank communication; recurring leading indicator.
Single bank's IPR notice; valuable proxy evidence for non-public Flik rules, but a one-off page.
